paragraphs: Peachjar describes itself as a platform that connects families with local, regional, and national resources and programs supporting a child's development in and beyond the classroom. The homepage frames the work as a partnership with school districts nationwide, through which families are connected to resources outside of class. Programs named on the site include mental and physical health support, extracurricular activities, and college or career readiness.

The same page says the company partners with school districts to connect families to free and affordable programs, including state and federal resources. Parents and guardians are named as the people who navigate the site to find options for their children. Schools have used Peachjar to reach parents with programs since 2013, according to the homepage.
The about page dates the company to 2013 and credits its founding to Michael Durham.

quote.text: Peachjar partners with school districts to connect families to free and affordable programs, including state and federal resources that make a difference.
